card.name: Frigate Bird Dance (Nauru)
card.profile: Among documented Nauruan dances (with dogoropa and the historical fish dance, the latter surviving only in photographs); circular reigen dances noted; much eroded by colonial influence. Recorded by David Fanshawe ("Frigate Bird Dance, Nauru," Spirit of Polynesia 1993).
